text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - elevated 5xx rate and streaming timeouts in eu-west-1. Paging oncall @mike.alvarez and ops. Auto-routing to fallback model enabled.

mike.alvarez: I'm on it. seeing 20-30% 502/504 on streaming websocket proxys. hitting the inference gateway at the shard layer. digging into recent deploys and kernel patches.

mike.alvarez: quick note — I'm going to open a debug runbook and shadow traffic to a warm fallback pool to reduce customer-facing errors. will update status page once mitigation is confirmed.

olivia.park: on call handover in 45m, fyi. if you need a hand later I can take post-handoff incident lead.

mike.alvarez: thanks @olivia. current plan: 1) rollback the last GPU runtime kernel change on the eu fleet (in 5m window), 2) activate extra routing to dedicated fallback for streaming, 3) post initial status. starting step 1 now.

sarah.chen: marketing here — need draft copy for status page + customer email + social. keep wording consistent across channels and stick to status page link. please share proposed text for quick approval.

mike.alvarez: status page draft (short):

"We are investigating elevated error rates and streaming timeouts in eu-west-1 affecting hosted API responses. Some customers may experience failed or delayed streaming outputs. Our engineers are actively mitigating and we will update when service is restored."

mike.alvarez: ETA for next update ~20min after rollback finishes.

raj.patel: customer-impact note: telemetry shows 12 production tenants with >10% error rate, several PLG customers with active sockets. recommend targeted notify for tenants above 15% via in-app banner + email.

marketing-lead: draft for social (tweet):

"We're aware of an issue causing higher-than-normal errors and streaming interruptions for some customers in EU. We're investigating and working on a fix — updates at https://status.redwood.ai. Apologies for the disruption."

marketing-lead: need legal signoff on "some customers" phrasing? @legal-bot any flags here?

legal-bot: no legal blockers for that wording. avoid promising specific ETA. link to status page is good.

mike.alvarez: rollback completed. initial routing to fallback pool engaged. error rate dropped from ~28% to ~6% in the last 3 minutes. continuing to monitor.

ops-bot: Deploy rollback executed by mike.alvarez at 12:37 UTC. Health checks passing on 90% of nodes.

mike.alvarez: monitoring shows client reconnections are succeeding. will wait 10 more minutes for stability before posting "partial mitigation" status.

olivia.park: taking over the incident in 35m. mike, please send me the troubleshooting notes and commands you ran so I can pick up.

mike.alvarez: copying runbook steps and diagnostics below:

```
# rollback command
redwood deploy rollback --cluster eu-west-1 --service inference-runtime --to-rev abc123
# route switch
redwood routing set-fallback --region eu-west-1 --percent 30
# check
redwood monitor tail --filter inference.gateway.errors --since 15m
```

mike.alvarez: suggested status page update for partial mitigation:

"Update 12:45 UTC: Partial mitigation implemented. Error rates have significantly decreased due to rollback and routing changes. Some customers may still see intermittent errors; we continue to monitor and work toward full recovery."

sarah.chen: customer email template (short):

"Subject: Service interruption affecting streaming in EU — update

Hi —
We're investigating an issue causing intermittent streaming failures for some customers in EU. We have implemented mitigations that have reduced errors, and are continuing to work toward full restoration. For the latest updates, please see https://status.redwood.ai. Sorry for the disruption.

— Redwood Ops"

marketing-lead: posting cadence — status page immediately, customer email in 30 if errors remain >5% for same tenants, social after status page update and legal ok.

raj.patel: confirm targeted in-app banners — I'll queue banners for tenants above threshold. use the customer email body truncated to one sentence + status link.

legal-bot: approved. no additional language changes.

mike.alvarez: error rate holding ~5% for global; EU region ~6%. recommend post partial mitigation on status page now.

sarah.chen: approved. final social copy (marketing):

"We experienced elevated errors affecting streaming for some customers in EU. Mitigations are in place and service is improving. For ongoing details see https://status.redwood.ai. We apologize for the disruption."

marketing-lead: scheduling social post in 5 minutes after status page update. will attach thread ID to status entry.

olivia.park: taking lead now — mike handing off logs + commands. I'll manage post-recovery checks and run a postmortem doc. tagging @sarah.chen and @raj.patel for comms and customer follow-up.

mike.alvarez: handing over — pinned diagnostics in #eng-infra and exported logs to incident artifact. good luck. :thumbsup:

sarah.chen: thanks team. after full recovery we'll coordinate a short postmortem + comms note for customers impacted >15%. please add any customer-specific context to the PM notes.

ops-bot: Incident marked "partial mitigation" at 12:47 UTC by olivia.park.

olivia.park: I'll update here when we declare full recovery and after PR for root cause is ready.

incident-bot: If no further escalation, please close or convert to follow-up when incident concludes.
